PreGame Demo

# 1. Get a build-partition session on HPC

# 2. Load Python 3.9 env
```{bash}
module load R/4.5.2                      
export CONDA_PKGS_DIRS=~/.conda_pkgs_cache
mamba create -p ~/envs/pregame python=3.9.6 -y
module unload R/4.5.2                    # otherwise the R module's python shadows the env
conda activate ~/envs/pregame
python --version                         #3.9.6
```
To activate this environment, use:

    mamba activate /cluster/xxx/envs/pregame

Or to execute a single command in this environment, use:

    mamba run -p /cluster/xxx/pregame mycommand


# 3. Install the pinned packages
```{bash}
pip install numpy==1.26.3 pandas==2.2.0 scikit-learn==1.1.3 imbalanced-learn==1.0.0 2>/dev/null || true
pip install numpy==1.26.3 pandas==2.2.0 scikit-learn==1.1.3 imbalanced-learn==0.12.4 joblib==1.3.1
pip install pyarrow jupyter nbconvert ipykernel
```

# 4. Check it works
```{bash}
python -c "import sklearn, imblearn, numpy, pandas, joblib, pyarrow; print(sklearn.__version__, imblearn.__version__, numpy.__version__, pandas.__version__)"
```

# 5. Get the demo files onto the cluster
```{bash}
mkdir -p ~/PreGame && cd ~/PreGame

# download the notebooks and demo data from the Zenodo record page (use the file links from that page):
# 1_Train_PreGame.ipynb, 2_Run_PreGame.ipynb, meta_discovery_tested.tsv,
# PreGame_testing_matrix.feather, PreGame_testing_labels.tsv

wget "https://zenodo.org/records/20028241?preview_file=1_Train_PreGame.ipynb" -O 1_Train_PreGame.ipynb
```
Or download them locally and `scp` them over. 
NOTE: scp is more recommended as the above link goes to preview file.


# 6. Run the demo on a normal partition (not build)
The demo takes about 2 minutes. 
```{bash}
conda activate ~/envs/pregame
cd ~/PreGame
jupyter nbconvert --to notebook --execute 1_Train_PreGame.ipynb --output 1_done.ipynb
jupyter nbconvert --to notebook --execute 2_Run_PreGame.ipynb --output 2_done.ipynb
```
The demo labels are randomized, so the trained demo model is meaningless. 
This run only checks that the code works.

Demo results:
1_done.ipynb            
2_done.ipynb  
PreGame_Predictions.tsv 
PreGame_testing_models.pkl        
PreGame_testing_feature_importance.csv
